sections.body: A generic contact box can send a borrower, partner and media request into the same queue. Those are different tasks and should be handled differently.

sections.heading: HOW TO APPROACH IT
sections.body: Choose funding inquiries for capital needs, partnership inquiries for referral or distribution programs, and general inquiries for other business matters. Use existing approved forms and inboxes; Core does not store submissions.

sections.heading: YOUR NEXT MOVE
sections.body: For a general question, the existing website publishes admin@distilledfunding.com. Do not send financial documents to this general address without a secure approved process.
